description: Buy a pack of prepaid runs, cheaper than paying per call (€0.50). €5.00 buys 100 runs (€0.05 each), valid 365 days. A run is used only when a call would otherwise need a payment: an AI tool with no account or no credits left, or a call past a limit an account would lift. A call that fails gives its run back. Needs a payment-enabled client (Stripe Link agent wallet, MPP): call it, and the refusal carries the payment request in _meta under "org.paymentauth/payment-required"; ask the user to approve €5.00, then repeat the call with the credential. The key then pays automatically for the rest of this conversation. Only offer this when the user has hit a limit and wants to pay; a free account (create_account) is the free route.
name: buy_prepaid_runs
title: Buy prepaid HelpySelf runs
